workshop.prompt:
Create one exceptional, finished editorial PIXEL ART panorama for the public welcome page of HACK DISTRICT, a Bay Area community making hackathons, creative software, and electronic hardware. Art only: no words, typography, symbols resembling letters, logo, labels, UI borders, or watermark. Very wide landscape about 2.5:1. Premium monochrome 16-bit pixel-art craftsmanship, not cheap tiny flat icons or an AI poster collage. Strict neutral grayscale: ink black, charcoal, silver, offwhite and luminous white. The image must visibly consist of deliberate square pixel clusters, crisp stepped silhouettes, broad carefully designed value planes, selective short checkerboard transitions, a coherent logical pixel size like a master illustration drawn on a 640x256 grid then enlarged nearest-neighbor. NO photograph, photorealism, 3D-render aesthetic, blur, soft airbrush, noisy dithering over every surface, smooth anti-aliased vector contours, blue or purple tint.
Subject and composition: an elegant wide lunar maker station, a single long low workbench crossing the lower half of the image, viewed from a slightly elevated three-quarter angle. This is a sophisticated miniature world, built and connected, not separate floating items. At the left third a beautiful compact open laptop and one small silver circuit board on the desk; at the center an electronic badge prototype standing in a tiny cradle with a simple glowing moon on its screen, a neat soldering tool and a coiled lead; at the right third a charming small camera-eye lunar rover with four sturdy black wheels, white box camera head, narrow neck and small antenna resting at the end of the platform. A few restrained cables and carefully shaped dark recesses unify the station. Distinct purposeful proportions, excellent perspective, substantial hardware shapes, rich yet restrained pixel detail. No humans, flags, rockets, planets or generic business illustrations.
Environment: the bench is on a low stepped lunar rock platform with a thin bright rim and large calm rock facets. Wide deep-black sky around it with ONLY a handful of tiny square stars, and a very distant clean silver lunar horizon. Leave generous pure-black negative space across the upper third and at both outer edges so the composition breathes. No clutter. Workbench, laptop and rover are readable at web-header size. Bright upper-left highlights, luminous edges created with discrete pixel-value bands. Mature, quiet, expertly art-directed indie science-fiction concept art. Make this look like one lovingly illustrated world for people who build things, with exceptional composition and object design.
workshop.note: Concept illustration; exact pixel grid and palette are artistic directions, not claims about native generated pixels.

composition: Deterministic SVG composition with outlined Geist Pixel Square lettering, rendered through resvg and encoded as lossless WebP. Original illustration source pixels are retained in the included PNGs.
